name: Rimmon
title: The Beerothite, father of Baana and Rekab
summary: Rimmon was a Beerothite from the tribe of Benjamin and the father of Baana and Rekab. His two sons were military leaders during the reign of Ish-bosheth (Saul's son) and became known for killing Ish-bosheth and bringing his head to King David, who punished them with death for their wicked deed.

keyEvents.title: Rimmon's sons as military leaders
keyEvents.description: Rimmon's sons Baana and Rekab served as leaders of raiding bands during the reign of Ish-bosheth, Saul's son.

keyEvents.title: Rimmon's origin from Beeroth
keyEvents.description: Rimmon came from Beeroth, which was counted among the tribe of Benjamin. The people of Beeroth had fled to Gittaim.

keyEvents.title: The murder of Ish-bosheth
keyEvents.description: Rehoboam's sons Rechab and Baanah entered Ish-bosheth's house in the middle of the day and killed him while he was resting on his bed.

keyEvents.title: The Sons Bring Ish-bosheth's Head to David
keyEvents.description: Rechab and Baanah brought Ish-bosheth's head to David in Hebron, thinking they had done him a favor by killing his enemy.

keyEvents.title: David's Judgment on Rehoboam's Sons
keyEvents.description: David condemned the murder of an innocent man in his own house and ordered the execution of Baanah and Rechab. Their hands and feet were cut off, and they were hanged by the pool in Hebron.
